description: R3 single-variable control. Qwen1.5-4B-Chat holds head_dim at 128 and changes ONLY the GQA ratio (4:1 -> 1:1 MHA) against Qwen3-4B, in the same family at the same size. Session 3's contrast (Qwen3-4B 0.81 vs SmolLM2 0.54 at bucket 4096) moved head_dim AND GQA together and cannot say which caused the gradient. This run decides it: ~0.81 means head_dim drives it, ~0.54 means GQA does.
note_tp: 20 attention heads / 4 = 5 and intermediate 6912 / 4 = 1728, so TP=4 shards cleanly. granite-3.1-2b was rejected for exactly this (IndivisibleError).
note_confound: Not perfectly single-variable: 40 layers vs Qwen3-4B's 36, and Qwen3 adds QK-norm. But head_dim -- the axis RPA tiles on, and the one that moved in the SmolLM2 contrast -- is held fixed at 128, which is what the decomposition needs.
note_occupancy: Same fractions as every other e01 run. max_position_embeddings is 32768, so bucket 4096 at occupancy 1.0 is reachable -- this is why Qwen1.5 was chosen over OLMo-2-7B, which caps at 4096 positions and would have needed the most informative cell shrunk to fit an output token.
